</div></div><div class="w-separator size_small with_line style_solid color_border width_default align_center"><div class="w-separator-h"></div></div><div class="wpb_text_column"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><h3>Description</h3>
</div></div><div class="w-post-elm post_custom_field us_custom_7709e774 guesty-location type_text property_size color_link_inherit"><span class="w-post-elm-before">Property Size: </span><span class="w-post-elm-value">2,928 sq ft / 272 m²</span></div><div class="w-post-elm post_custom_field us_custom_4f24afa8 type_text summary color_link_inherit"><span class="w-post-elm-value">Experience elevated island living at Alizé Villa, a luxury four-bedroom vacation rental in the exclusive Windchaser Villas community on Long Bay Beach, Providenciales, Turks & Caicos. Combining contemporary design, exceptional comfort, and one of the island's most sought-after locations, Alizé Villa is the perfect destination for families, couples, and groups looking for a private Caribbean escape.</span></div><div class="w-tabs us_custom_4e1ed02b accordion type_togglable toggle_style_1 has_scrolling remove_indents" style="--sections-title-size:inherit;--sections-gap:0.5rem;"><div class="w-tabs-sections titles-align_none icon_chevron cpos_right"><div class="w-tabs-section" id="qaf0"><button type="button" class="w-tabs-section-header" aria-controls="content-qaf0" aria-expanded="false"><div class="w-tabs-section-title">The Space</div><div class="w-tabs-section-control"></div></button><div  class="w-tabs-section-content" id="content-qaf0"><div class="w-tabs-section-content-h i-cf"><div class="wpb_text_column"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><h3>The Space</h3>
</div></div><div class="w-post-elm post_content us_custom_92b2762d property-listing with_collapsible_content" itemprop="text" data-content-height="300px"><div><p>Just a short stroll from the soft white sands and crystal-clear waters of Long Bay Beach, the villa offers everything needed for a memorable vacation—from a private swimming pool and spacious indoor-outdoor living areas to beautifully appointed bedrooms and resort-style amenities.</p>
<p>The villa&#8217;s open-concept design embraces the Caribbean lifestyle with abundant natural light, airy interiors, and seamless transitions between indoor and outdoor spaces.</p>
<p>The fully equipped gourmet kitchen is ideal for preparing breakfast before heading to the beach or enjoying a private chef experience. Comfortable living and dining areas provide ample room for everyone to gather, while expansive glass doors open onto the outdoor terrace where you&#8217;ll find a private pool, shaded lounge areas, tropical gardens, and alfresco dining.</p>
<p>Each of the four spacious bedrooms has been thoughtfully designed with luxury linens, elegant finishes, and ensuite bathrooms, creating peaceful retreats after days spent exploring Providenciales.</p>
<p>One of the villa&#8217;s greatest features is its proximity to Long Bay Beach, one of Turks &amp; Caicos&#8217; most breathtaking stretches of coastline.</p>
<p>Unlike many Caribbean beaches, Long Bay is known for its shallow, calm turquoise waters that extend hundreds of feet offshore, making it ideal for families with children as well as paddleboarding, kayaking, swimming, and simply relaxing in warm, crystal-clear water.</p>
<p>The steady trade winds have also made Long Bay internationally recognized as one of the world&#8217;s premier kiteboarding destinations.</p>
<p>Whether you&#8217;re watching the sunrise, taking a morning walk along miles of pristine shoreline, or enjoying an afternoon in the sea, Long Bay offers a peaceful alternative to busier beaches while remaining only minutes from Grace Bay.</p>
<h3>KEY FEATURES</h3>
<ul>
<li>Four beautifully furnished bedrooms</li>
<li>Four and a half bathrooms</li>
<li>Private swimming pool</li>
<li>Outdoor lounge and dining areas</li>
<li>Gourmet kitchen</li>
<li>Smart TVs</li>
<li>Air conditioning throughout</li>
<li>BBQ grill</li>
<li>Washer and dryer</li>
<li>Access to the community tennis court</li>
</ul>
<h3>BEDROOMS</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Bedroom 1:</strong> King bed, air-conditioning, pool/garden view</li>
<li><strong>Bedroom 2:</strong> King bed, air-conditioning, pool/garden view</li>
<li><strong>Bedroom 3:</strong> King bed or two twin beds, air-conditioning, pool/garden view, kitchenette</li>
<li><strong>Bedroom 4:</strong> Queen, air-conditioning, pool/garden view, kitchenette</li>
</ul>

<h3>TKCA VACATION RENTALS VIA TRUVI</h3>
<ul>
<li>We are committed to protecting our properties, which is why we&#8217;ve partnered with Know Your Guest, the leading vacation rental guest-screening provider.</li>
<li>Please note that before your booking begins, you will need to verify your details through Know Your Guest.</li>
<li>A non-refundable damage waiver amounting to $210 is required. This protects you if there is accidental damage of up to $3,000 to the property during the stay.</li>
</ul>
<h3>UTILITIES</h3>
<ul>
<li>The cost of electricity in the Turks &amp; Caicos Islands has always been very expensive. This is further exacerbated by recent global increases in fuel pricing which have put this cost at an all-time high.</li>
<li>All guests are asked to be mindful of their energy consumption and particularly as it relates to Air Conditioning (AC). If you are running the AC, please ensure doors and windows remain closed.</li>
<li>The owner of your vacation rental will cover up to $60.00/day (sixty US Dollars) for electricity consumption. On the last day of this rental, the meter will be read, and any amount over this allowance will be charged to the lessee&#8217;s card on file at a rate of $0.60 per KWH.</li>
</ul>

</div></div><div class="w-post-elm post_custom_field type_text notes color_link_inherit"><p>Beach and Shoreline Conditions</p>
<p>As with all Caribbean beaches, shoreline conditions may vary throughout the year. Seasonal sargassum seaweed may occasionally wash ashore, with conditions influenced by weather patterns and ocean currents.</p>

  
</div></div></div></div></div><div class="w-tabs-section" id="jafa"><button type="button" class="w-tabs-section-header" aria-controls="content-jafa" aria-expanded="false"><div class="w-tabs-section-title">House Rules</div><div class="w-tabs-section-control"></div></button><div  class="w-tabs-section-content us_custom_4c77c721" id="content-jafa"><div class="w-tabs-section-content-h i-cf"><div class="wpb_text_column"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><h3>House Rules</h3>
</div></div><section class="l-section wpb_row height_auto width_full"><div class="l-section-h i-cf"><div class="g-cols vc_row via_flex valign_top type_default stacking_default"><div class="vc_col-sm-12 wpb_column vc_column_container"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_raw_code wpb_raw_html wpb_content_element us_custom_909b2fd0" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<ul>
 	<li>Smoking, including E-cigarettes and Shisha Pipes, is strictly prohibited inside the property. Any breach of this rule will result in an immediate request for guests to vacate the villa without a refund. A penalty fee of $2,000 will also be charged for deep cleaning and shampoo of all soft furnishings.</li>
 	<li>Hosting parties and events on the premises is strictly prohibited and will result in eviction.</li>
 	<li>The Guest is not permitted to move or remove any furniture on the property. This includes indoor &amp; outdoor sofa cushions, which are to remain fixed to the furniture.</li>
 	<li>To ensure a comfortable stay, Lessee is encouraged to keep sliding doors closed to prevent bugs from entering the Villa.</li>
 	<li>The Guest is reminded to use only plastic cups and dishes around the pool deck and outdoor dining area.</li>
 	<li>We are located in a residential community and, although this is a holiday destination, it's home to many people. As such we ask that you respect their privacy and their right to a peaceful existence! Specifically, between the hours of 10pm and 8am noise should be kept to respectful levels.</li>
 	<li>Due to the septic system, the Guest must only flush toilet paper. Sanitary wipes and female products should not be flushed to prevent plumbing issues.</li>
 	<li>For emergency services (ambulance, police, fire) please immediately call 911.
<ul>
 	<li>Do not delay if you feel an emergency situation has arisen. State your location as the address on the front page of this guidebook.</li>

 	<li>In case of a fire, find the nearest exit point as quickly as possible. Ensure that all persons are accounted for.</li>
 	<li>Dial 911 and ask for ‘FIRE’.</li>
 	<li>State your location (see the front page of this book).</li>
 	<li>Do not attempt to re-enter the building until a Fire Officer states that it is safe to do so.</li>
 	<li>Please also notify the Property Manager</li>
</ul></li></ul>
		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div></div></section>
